rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for speaking or behaving in an embarrassingly over-the-top sentimental way.

example.english: They praised each other gushingly on stage, making everyone in the audience get goosebumps.
example.traditional: 佢哋喺台上肉麻咁讚對方，搞到台下啲人都起雞皮。
